# Hygiene and Shadow-Work Discovery During Full Render

The Awtsmoos lets one proof run while another light searches the edges; Awtsmoos.com records every structural debt so final success cannot hide a file that still exceeds the covenant.

## Read-only scan evidence
- The active full proof is using loaded canonical compiler/render/export modules; those files are frozen from mutation until the browser reaches terminal state.
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentNormalizer.js` is currently 131 lines and therefore violates the project's 120-line ceiling.
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/RealMovieBrowserExportPage.js` is currently 121 lines and also violates the ceiling.
- Both require full reads, planning, and whole-file modular rewrites after the 180-second proof is safely terminal.
- The movie workspace contains concurrent modifications and untracked modules from multiple movie-system passes; final hygiene must distinguish files authored by this mission from concurrent agent work before any rewrite.

## Current visible modified movie surface
Observed modified files include the three-minute intent, Animator plan parts, canonical browser export/frame source/export plan, the canonical proof pages, shared capabilities/compiler/compatibility bridge/semantic kinds, and frame-backpressure test. New files include dialogue projection, ffmpeg regressions, cinematic vocabulary test, voice assets/specification/generator, capability recommender, intent adapter/normalizer, and compatibility envelope work.

## Interpretation
- Modified/untracked status is evidence of a shared workspace, not permission to reset it.
- Some listed files are concurrent-agent changes and must be fresh-read/fresh-hashed before any later mutation.
- The oversized normalizer is especially sensitive because it participates in canonical intent compilation. It must not be rewritten while the active full render depends on its loaded semantics.

## REMAINING_WORK additions
1. Split `MovieIntentNormalizer.js` below 120 lines without reducing comments or minifying logic.
2. Split `RealMovieBrowserExportPage.js` below 120 lines without changing legacy proof behavior.
3. Re-scan every human-authored movie source for >120 lines after all repairs.
4. Check tabs on actual code indentation while excluding JSDoc ` *` lines from false-positive leading-space scans.
5. Re-check mandatory B"H/Boruch Hashem/Blessed is He prologues and Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com mentions on touched source.
6. Syntax-check every touched JS/MJS and py_compile every touched Python source after final rewrites.
7. Reread every source file touched by this mission after the final write pass.
8. Preserve concurrent-agent modifications; never reset or overwrite without fresh evidence.

## NEXT_ACTION
Keep the full render target untouched. Continue read-only/documentation shadow work until the 360-frame milestone watcher returns.
